Dholuo: Bed achiel kuom joma jiwo weche thieth, thieth, kod kuonde ma ji dhiyoe e skul.

English: Support mobile legal aid and educational outreach for rural or marginalized communities.
Kiswahili: Saidia usaidizi wa kisheria unaoendeshwa kwa simu na ufikiaji wa elimu kwa jamii za vijijini au zilizotengwa.
Dholuo: Riw lwedo chenro mar konyo joma odak e alwora mar gweng' kata joma ok nie winjruok maber gi Nyasaye.

English: Participate in programs advocating for mental health, gender equality, and disability rights.
Kiswahili: Shiriki katika programu zinazotetea afya ya akili, usawa wa kijinsia, na haki za ulemavu.
Dholuo: Dhi e chokruoge ma jiwo ji mondo obed gi paro mowinjore, gibed gi winjruok maber e kind chwo gi mon, kendo gibed gi ratiro mar bedo gi midekre.

English: Report child labor, forced marriage, and abuse to relevant authorities or hotlines.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ajira ya watoto, ndoa ya kulazimishwa, na unyanyasaji kwa mamlaka husika au simu za dharura.
Dholuo: Nyis jotelo kata joma tiyo gi simo ni itiyo gi nyithindo e tich, ikendgi gi thuon, kendo iti gi joma itiyogo e timo timbe mag achaya.

English: Support education and awareness campaigns protecting children, women, refugees, and vulnerable groups
Kiswahili: Saidia kampeni za elimu na uhamasishaji kuwalinda watoto, wanawake, wakimbizi, na makundi yaliyo hatarini
Dholuo: Tiyo gi yore mag puonjo kod chiwo paro e rito nyithindo, mon, joma oringo thuchegi, kod joma nigi chandruok

English: Use community platforms to educate on disaster preparedness, emergency numbers, and safety protocols
Kiswahili: Tumia majukwaa ya jamii kuelimisha kuhusu maandalizi ya maafa, nambari za dharura, na itifaki za usalama
Dholuo: Ti gi chenro mag kanyakla mondo ikony ji ng'eyo kaka ginyalo timo ne masiche, kwan mag joma nigi namba mar chiwo kony, kod chike ma tayo ritruok

English: Bevigilant students are tricked into smuggling narcotics
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi makini wadanganywa ili kusafirisha dawa za kulevya kimagendo
Dholuo: Jopuonjre ma nigi chuny mar rito jonywolgo, wuondi mondo otergi e wuoth

English: Encourage proper vehicle maintenance, child safety, and driver education programs
Kiswahili: Kuhimiza matengenezo sahihi ya gari, usalama wa mtoto, na programu za elimu ya udereva
Dholuo: Jiw chenro mag rito mtoka e yo makare, rito nyithindo, kendo tiego dereba

English: Be on the lookout for criminals who use NGOs to launder money
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu na wahalifu wanaotumia mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali kutakasa pesa
Dholuo: Bed motang ' gi jomahundu ma tiyo gi riwruoge ma ok riw lwedo e lwoko pesa

English: Report road accidents, unsafe vehicles, and reckless driving to authorities.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ajali za barabarani, magari yasiyo salama, na uendeshaji wa magari bila kujali kwa mamlaka.
Dholuo: Nyis sirkal ka in gi aksident, mtokni ma ok ni kare, kod ka idwaro riembo mtoka.

English: Share tips and awareness on safe driving practices, traffic regulations, and accident prevention
Kiswahili: Shiriki vidokezo na ufahamu kuhusu desturi salama za kuendesha gari, kanuni za trafiki, na kuzuia ajali
Dholuo: Chiw paro kod paro e wi weche motudore gi riembo mtoka, chike mag ndara, kod geng'o aksident

English: Participate in public safety campaigns and trainings in schools, markets, and transport hubs
Kiswahili: Shiriki katika kampeni na mafunzo ya usalama wa umma katika shule, masoko, na vituo vya usafiri
Dholuo: Riw lwedo kampen mag rito ngima ji kod tiegruok e skunde, e chiro, kod kuonde ma ji wuokie

English: Beware of Criminals posing as embassy staff to commit fraud
Kiswahili: Jihadhari na Wahalifu wanaojifanya wafanyakazi wa ubalozi ili kufanya ulaghai
Dholuo: Tang ' gi Joma Timbegi Richo ma Timore Kaka Jatich e Ofise mag Ambassade Mondo Gitim Miriambo

English: Report biosecurity threats such as seed or livestock smuggling to KEPHIS or local authorities
Kiswahili: Ripoti vitisho vya usalama wa kibiolojia kama vile ulanguzi wa mbegu au mifugo kwa KEPHIS au mamlaka za mitaa

Dholuo: Jatend wakeini e kaunti ma Murang'a Betty Maina jiwo jodak  mondo obed gi horruok ne jotend sirkal ma osekawo migepe mopogore opogore mag siasa, komedo jiwo ni gin gi ratiro mar timo kamano.

English: Kwale Governor Fatuma Achani has urged residents across Kwale County, especially those living in arid areas of Kinango, Samburu, and Lungalunga, to plant more trees as a way to combat the ongoing drought affecting those regions.
Kiswahili: Gavana wa Kwale Fatuma Achani amewasihi wakazi kote Kaunti ya Kwale, hasa wale wanaoishi katika maeneo kame ya Kinango, Samburu, na Lungalunga, kupanda miti zaidi kama njia ya kupambana na ukame unaoendelea kuathiri maeneo hayo.
Dholuo: Jatend kaunti  miluongo ni Fatima Akanii osenyiso ji ni mondo gipidh yiende mang'eny e alwora mar Kwale, to ahinya jomodak e alwora mar Kinango, Samburu, kod Lungula mondo okony e oro momako gwengego.

English: Governor Mbarire urges residents to embrace the project
Kiswahili: Gavana Mbarire awahimiza wakazi kukumbatia mradi huo
Dholuo: Gavana Mbarire jiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo tijno

English: Govt commissions boreholes in Habaswein, Wajir county. PS Ronoh urges residents to embrace irrigation farming
Kiswahili: Serikali yazindua visima virefu huko Habaswein, kaunti ya Wajir. Katibu Mkuu Ronoh awahimiza wakazi kukumbatia kilimo cha umwagiliaji
Dholuo: gavana ochako gero kisimbe e Habaswein, kaunti ma Wajir. jagoro Ronoh jiwo ji mondo omak tije mag eyo mar tindo pi.

English: Meru County Commissioner urges residents who need government services to make use of Huduma Centre.
Kiswahili: Kamishna wa Kaunti ya Meru anawasihi wakazi wanaohitaji huduma za serikali kutumia Kituo cha Huduma.
Dholuo: Komisona ma Kaunti ma Meru jiwo ji duto madwaro kony moa kuom sirkal mondo oti gi huduma centers maber.

English: Political leaders allied to the broad-based government urge citizens to shun divisive politics from the opposition.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa kisiasa wanaoshirikiana na serikali pana waliwahimiza raia kuepuka siasa zinazowagawanya wapinzani.
Dholuo: Jotend siasa ne oriwore gi sirkal  maduong' ma jiwo raia mondo kik giriw lwedo siasa ma kelo pogruok.

English: The Baringo Ecosystem: Residents take up conservation agenda Residents urged to guard against exploitation
Kiswahili: Mfumo Ikolojia wa Baringo: Wakazi waanza ajenda ya uhifadhi Wakazi wahimizwa kujilinda dhidi ya unyonyaji
Dholuo: Alwora mar Baringo: Jo modak e alworano ne ojiw mondo otang' kik ti kodgi marach.

English: CALL FOR CONSERVATION Embu residents urged to adopt a tree planting culture
Kiswahili: WITO WA UHIFADHI Wakazi wa Embu wahimizwa kufuata utamaduni wa upandaji miti
Dholuo: luong mar rito  jodak e kaunti ma Embu onjiw mondo gibed gi kido kod tim mar pidho yien.

English: Conserving degraded lands: Nakuru residents urged to help in protecting lands next rivers.
Kiswahili: Kuhifadhi ardhi zilizoharibika: Wakazi wa Nakuru wahimizwa kusaidia katika kulinda ardhi iliyo karibu na mito.
Dholuo: Rito lowo ma ne okethore: Jo-Nakuru ne ojiw  mondo okony e rit lope manie geng aore.

English: Egesa Career Clinic: Egesa FM presenters conduct sensitization programme in Kisii Presenters urged residents urged to embrace technical courses
Kiswahili: Kliniki ya Kazi ya Egesa: Watangazaji wa Egesa FM waendesha programu ya uhamasishaji huko Kisii Watangazaji waliwasihi wakazi kukumbatia kozi za kiufundi
Dholuo: twak mar tije Egesa: Jolendo mag od lendo mar Egesa timo chenro mar chiwo paro ne jo Kisii ne okwayo jogweng'no mondo omakgi gi tiegruok mag lony ma nyasani.

English: East African ocean festival: Residents urged to take part in cleaning the beaches Beach cleaning exercise held in Nyali, Mombasa County
Kiswahili: Tamasha la bahari ya Afrika Mashariki: Wakazi wahimizwa kushiriki katika kusafisha fukwe Zoezi la usafi wa fukwe lililofanyika Nyali, Kaunti ya Mombasa
Dholuo: Nyasi mag nam ma Afrika ma Ugwe: Jopiny ojiw mondo oriw lwedo tiegruok mar pwodho nam ma ne otim Nyali, kaunti ma Mombasa.

English: Embu county residents urged to turn up in large numbers to welcome the President.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa kaunti ya Embu wamehimizwa kujitokeza kwa wingi kumkaribisha Rais.
Dholuo: Jodak ma Kaunti ma Embu okwayo mondo oriwre mang'eny mondo orwak ker.

English: INCREASING FOREST COVER 14,000 trees planted in Kitui Residents urged to continue planting trees
Kiswahili: Kuongezeka kwa Misitu Miti 14,000 iliyopandwa Kitui Wakazi wahimizwa kuendelea kupanda miti
Dholuo: Medruok mar bunge mar yiende yiende alufu apar kod ang'wen ma opidhi e Kitui. Jopiny  ojiw mondo odhi nyime gi pidho yiende.

English: Residents urged to participate in the budget making process through public participation, to familiarize with projects initiated by the County Govt.
Kiswahili: Wakazi walisihiwa kushiriki katika mchakato wa kutengeneza bajeti kupitia ushiriki wa umma, ili kufahamu miradi iliyoanzishwa na Serikali ya Kaunti.
Dholuo: Ji ne ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo bajetno kokalo kuom riwruok mar oganda, kendo mondo ging'e chenro ma sirkal mar kaunti'no osechako.

English: KRA ON THE ROAD Tax man tours Mombasa County, residents urged to file their returns
Kiswahili: KRA ON THE ROAD Mtoza ushuru azuru Kaunti ya Mombasa, wakazi wahimizwa kuwasilisha marejesho yao
Dholuo: KRA e yoo. Jasol osuru otimo limbe e kaunti mar  Mombasa, jodak ojiw mondo ochiw duoko mar osuru.

English: MALINDI COHESION CALLS Residents urged to be wary of politicians sowing seeds of discord Local leaders want action taken against politicians propagating hate
Kiswahili: WITO WA UMOJA WA MALINDI WAWAKILISHA Wakazi kuwa waangalifu na wanasiasa wanaopanda mbegu za kutoelewana Viongozi wa eneo hilo wanataka hatua zichukuliwe dhidi ya wanasiasa wanaoeneza chuki
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Malindi jiwo ji mondo otang ' gi josiasa ma chwoyo kodhi mag jotelo mag gweng'no, dwaro okang' okaw ne jotelo majiwo akwede.

English: Meru residents urged to elect leaders of integrity.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Meru wahimizwa kuwachagua viongozi waadilifu.
Dholuo: Jo-Meru ne ojiw mondo oyier jotelo makare.

English: Nyahururu unclaimed assets Residents urged to claim cash, sureties held at Nyahururu courts Keago: Assets remain uncollected despite case conclusions
Kiswahili: Mali ambazo hazijadaiwa Nyahururu Wakazi wahimizwa kudai pesa taslimu na wadhamini walioshikiliwa katika mahakama za Nyahururu Keago: Mali bado hazijakusanywa licha ya hitimisho la kesi
Dholuo: Joma odak e dala mar Nyahururu oweyo dwaro mwandu  jodak  ojiw mondo odonj e kot ma Nyahururu romo otim e od bura mar Nyahururu mwandu pok okaw kata obedo ni bura oserumo.

English: Kilifi residents urged  to register for SHA
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Kilifi wahimizwa kujiandikisha kwa SHA
Dholuo: Jo-Kilifi okwa mondo ondikre ne yor chudo mar SHA

English: Hospitals urged to embrace and provide services under SHA
Kiswahili: Hospitali zahimizwa kukumbatia na kutoa huduma chini ya SHA
Dholuo: Osiptende ojiwo mondo orwaki kendo ochiw kony e bwo chenro mar SHA

English: Egesa FM hosts career clinic in Nyamira county. Residents urged to embrace technical courses.
Kiswahili: Egesa FM inaandaa kliniki ya kazi katika kaunti ya Nyamira. Wakazi wahimizwa kukumbatia kozi za kiufundi.
Dholuo: Od lendo mar Egesa obedo kod twak e Kaunti ma Nyamira . Jodak ojiw mondo orwak somo motenore kod lony ma nyasani.

English: KEEPING THE DOCTOR AWAY ¦ Free medical camp held in Machakos town Residents urged to go for frequent medical checks
Kiswahili: KUMWEKA DAKTARI MBALI ¦ Kambi ya matibabu ya bure yafanyika mjini Machakos Wakazi wahimizwa kwenda kwa uchunguzi wa kimatibabu mara kwa mara
Dholuo: Bedo mabor gi laktar  romo manono oket e taon ma Machakos jodak ojiw mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth kinde ka kinde.

English: UDA PARTY ELECTIONS Homabay residents urged to exercise peace as UDA party elections gets underway.
Kiswahili: UCHAGUZI WA CHAMA CHA UDA Wakazi wa Homabay wahimizwa kudumisha amani wakati uchaguzi wa chama cha UDA unapoanza.
Dholuo: Yiero mar od bura mar UDA Jodak ma Homabay nojiwo ji mondo oti gi kuwe e kinde mag yiero mar duond od bura mar UDA.

English: Tharaka Nithi residents urged to plant more trees particularly in community lands.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Tharaka Nithi wahimizwa kupanda miti zaidi hasa katika ardhi za jamii.
Dholuo: Joma nodak Tharaka Nithi nokwayo mondo oger yiende mang'eny, to ahinya wuon e pinje ma ne odak machiegni kodgi.

English: Tana River residents urged to reject attempts by politicians to divide them along ethnic lines for personal gain.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Tana River wahimizwa kukataa majaribio ya wanasiasa ya kuwagawanya kwa misingi ya kikabila kwa ajili ya faida zao binafsi.
Dholuo: Jodak e Aora Tana nojiw mondo okwed pogruok ma josiasa ne timo e kindgi mondo giyud ber giwegi.

English: Residents urged to embrace the Taifa Care program
Kiswahili: Wakazi wahimizwa kukumbatia mpango wa Taifa Care
Dholuo: Jodak ojiw mondo owe chenro mar Taifa Care

English: Residents urged to embrace alternative dispute resolution
Kiswahili: Wakazi wahimizwa kukumbatia utatuzi mbadala wa migogoro
Dholuo: Jodak e alworano ojiw mondo oti kod yore mamoko mag tieko tulo.

English: Kiambu residents urged to collect their IDS
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Kiambu wahimizwa kuchukua vitambulisho vyao vya kitambulisho
Dholuo: Jo-Kiambu ojiw  mondo odhi okaw opande mekgi.

English: 0ver 200,000 propagules planted along the Coastal Stretch CSs led the exercise across the coastal region Residents urged to embrace the exercise in a bid to salvage their livelihood.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa eneo la pwani waliomba kukumbatia zoezi hilo kwa lengo la kuokoa maisha yao.
Dholuo: Cham moloyo alufu mia ariyo  opidh e dho wath ma ne ni machiegni gi dho nam, Jatend migawo ne otelo ne  tijno e dho wath jodak ojiw mondo orwak tijno mondo okony e ngimagi mapile.

English: Kakamega County residents urged to sign up for affordable housing
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega wahimizwa kujisajili kwa nyumba za bei nafuu
Dholuo: Joma odak e gweng' mar Kakamega ne okwayo mondo gikwong giyie gi ot ma nigi nengo mamalo

English: Laikipia residents urged to join NHIF to avoid seeking hospital waivers
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Laikipia wahimizwa kujiunga na NHIF ili kuepuka kuomba msamaha wa hospitali
Dholuo: Jo-Laikipia ojiw mondo oriwre gi NHIF mondo giwe manyo thieth manono.

English: Lamu residents urged to protect wildlife for future generations' benefit
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Lamu wahimizwa kulinda wanyamapori kwa manufaa ya vizazi vijavyo
Dholuo: Jodak Lamu okwa mondo orit le mag bungu mondo okony tieng' mabiro.

English: Saving Marsabit Forests: Measures launched to protect forests and water bodies in the county Stakeholders urged to sensitise residents to help combat degradation Residents urged to plant trees to protect water catchment areas
Kiswahili: Kuokoa Misitu ya Marsabit: Hatua zilizozinduliwa kulinda misitu na vyanzo vya maji katika kaunti Wadau wahimizwa kuhamasisha wakazi kusaidia kupambana na uharibifu Wakazi wahimizwa kupanda miti ili kulinda maeneo ya vyanzo vya maji
Dholuo: Konyo bungu mar Masabit: Chenro mag rito bunge kod yiende mag pi e kaunti'no ne ojiw jokanyo ne ojwi mondo owuo kod jodak mondo okony e rito lowo ojiw jodak mondo opidh yiende mondo oywa pi.

English: COVID-19 MASS TESTING NMS launches two mass testing in Nairobi Residents urged to turn up to be tested
Kiswahili: UPIMAJI WA WALIMU WA COVID-19 NMS YAZINDUA UPIMAJI WA WALIMU WAWILI jijini Nairobi Wakazi wahimizwa kujitokeza kupimwa
Dholuo: Pim mar COVID-19 riwruok mar NMS chako nonro mar ji ariyo ne jodak mar  Nairobi jodak  ne ojiw mondo  opim.

English: Commission on administrative justice opens Garissa office; residents urged to report issues that need attention.
Kiswahili: Tume ya haki ya utawala yafungua ofisi ya Garissa; wakazi wahimizwa kuripoti masuala yanayohitaji kushughulikiwa.
Dholuo: Kamisen mar adiera e telo oyawo apis ma Garisa , Jodak ojiw mondo ochiw ripot e wi weche madwarore ahinya.

English: NAROK FOREST CONSERVATION: Residents urged to plant more trees to increase forest cover in the county
Kiswahili: UHIFADHI WA MSITU WA NAROK: Wakazi wahimizwa kupanda miti zaidi ili kuongeza eneo la misitu katika kaunti hiyo
Dholuo: Rito bungu ma Narok: Jodak ojiw mondo opidh yiende mang'eny mondo omi bunge omedre e kaunti'no.

English: Embu residents urged to register with NHIF to scale up  UHC
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Embu wahimizwa kujisajili na NHIF ili kuongeza UHC
Dholuo: Jodak  Embu ne ojiw mondo ondikre gi  NHIF mondo gimed bedo gi UHC

English: Citizens urged to register with the new medical cover (SHA)
Kiswahili: Raia wahimizwa kujiandikisha na bima mpya ya matibabu (SHA)
Dholuo: Ne ojiw raia mondo odonj e chenro manyien mar thieth (SHA)

English: Leaders from Tana River County urged to collaborate to ensure citizens benefit from development projects.
Kiswahili: Viongozi kutoka Kaunti ya Tana River wamehimizwa kushirikiana ili kuhakikisha raia wananufaika na miradi ya maendeleo.
Dholuo: Jotelo ma Kaunti ma  Tana River ojiw  mondo oti kanyachiel mondo gine ni ji duto yudo ber kuom chenro mag dongruok.

English: SHA ENROLLMENT Deputy Gov't Spokesperson Mwanaisha Chidzuga has urged citizens to enroll in SHA, which aims to improve healthcare services and provide protection against high medical costs.
Kiswahili: UANDIKISHAJI WA SHA Naibu Msemaji wa Serikali Mwanaisha Chidzuga amewasihi raia kujiandikisha katika SHA, ambayo inalenga kuboresha huduma za afya na kutoa ulinzi dhidi ya gharama kubwa za matibabu.
Dholuo: Ndikruok e SHA Jalup jaloso elo sirkal Mwanaisha Chidzuga osenyiso ji ni gidonj e SHA, ma dwaro ni ji otim dongruok e weche thieth kendo gimi ji ritruok kuom nengo mag thieth.

English: NATIONAL ID PROCESSING Public urged to collect documents from respective constituencies Mwaura: 660,000 IDs awaiting collection 600,000 citizens have applied for new documents
Kiswahili: USAFIRISHAJI WA VItambulisho VYA TAIFA Umma wahimizwa kukusanya hati kutoka maeneo bunge husika Mwaura: Vitambulisho 660,000 vinasubiri kuchukuliwa Raia 600,000 wameomba hati mpya
Dholuo: Loco opande mar piny . Jopiny ojiw mondo ochok barupe moa e kuonde ka kuonde: Mwaura alufu mia auchiel gi piero auchiel Opande rito choko Jii alufu mia auchiel osendikore mar kawo barupe manyien.

English: The Director highlighted the role of Missions in harnessing Diaspora Investments. He Urged Kenyans abroad to register at their nearest Kenya Embassy, stressing that the missions are the first point of contact between the nation and its diaspora citizens.
Kiswahili: Mkurugenzi huyo aliangazia jukumu la Misheni katika kutumia Uwekezaji wa Diaspora. Aliwahimiza Wakenya walio nje ya nchi kujiandikisha katika Ubalozi wao wa karibu wa Kenya, akisisitiza kwamba misheni hizo ndizo sehemu ya kwanza ya mawasiliano kati ya taifa na raia wake walio nje ya nchi.
Dholuo: Jatelono nojiwo migawo ma dinde nigo mar tiyo gi pesago e konyo joma odak e pinje mamoko, kendo nojiwo Jo-Kenya modak e pinje mamoko mondo odonj e ofisgi man machiegni gi Kenya, kojiwo ni misonari e okang' mokwongo mar tudruok e kind pinyno gi joma odak e pinje mamoko.

English: Citizens are urged to participate in this historic Madaraka Day celebration set to take place in Bungoma County for the first time. - PS Interior Dr. Raymond Omollo
Kiswahili: Raia wanahimizwa kushiriki katika sherehe hii ya kihistoria ya Siku ya Madaraka inayotarajiwa kufanyika katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kwa mara ya kwanza. - Katibu Mkuu wa Mambo ya Ndani Dkt. Raymond Omollo
Dholuo: Ji duto igwelo mondo oriwre kodgi e nyasi maduong' mar chieng' madaraka Ji ma ne ochakore e kaunti ma Bungoma . - jagoro mar weche mag arita Laktar  Raymond Omollo

English: EACC does not condone any form of corruption among staff. Kindly report the case you refer to through eacc@integrity.go.ke. Citizens are urged to beware of fraudsters impersonating EACC staff.
Kiswahili: EACC haikubaliani na aina yoyote ya ufisadi miongoni mwa wafanyakazi. Tafadhali ripoti kesi unayoirejelea kupitia eacc@integrity.go.ke. Raia wanahimizwa kuwa waangalifu dhidi ya wadanganyifu wanaojifanya wafanyakazi wa EACC.
Dholuo: EACC ok oyie gi mibadhi moro amora e kind jotich. Riwruogno orwako wachno kokalo kuom eacc@integrity.go.ke. Ojiw ji mondo otang' gi joma wuondore ni gin jotich e riwruok mar EACC.

English: Mwananchi views: Members of the public advised to read and understand the BBI report
Kiswahili: Maoni ya Mwananchi: Umma washauriwa kusoma na kuelewa ripoti ya BBI
Dholuo: paro mar japiny: Jopiny ojiw mondo osom kendo owinj ripot mar BBI

English: Thank you for your feedback. Please report all cases of corruption and bribery to EACCKenya
Kiswahili: Asante kwa maoni yako. Tafadhali ripoti kesi zote za ufisadi na rushwa kwa EACCKenya
Dholuo: Erokamano kuom dwoko mari. nyis weche duto motudore gi mibadhi kod asoya ne riwruok mar EACC Kenya.

English: You are most welcome to Integrity Centre or any of our regional offices. You can visit to report corruption or share knowledge on how best we can fight corruption.
Kiswahili: Karibu sana katika Kituo cha Uadilifu au ofisi yoyote ya mkoa wetu. Unaweza kutembelea ili kuripoti ufisadi au kushiriki maarifa kuhusu jinsi tunavyoweza kupambana na ufisadi.
Dholuo: Warwaki ahinya e apis mar Intergrity Center kata e ofis moro amora mar  gwenge. Inyalo limo ofisno mondo inyis ji wach mibadhi kata imiwa yo kaka wanyalo kedo gi mibadhi.

English: You are welcome to report corruption please call Toll Free line 1551 or email report@integrity.go.ke.
Kiswahili: Mwaareganigwe mwensi koenana amang'ana igoro y'obokurumi ase enchera yesimu ya bosa 1551 gose otome rirube riembeo report@integrity.go.ke
Dholuo: Warwaki mondo ichiw lipot mar mibadhi, tudri gi namba mar 1551 kata mbui mar  report@integrity.go.ke.

English: Good morning. We process number plates within 7 working days. Never deal with brokers. Report cases of corruption to @EACCKenya
Kiswahili: Habari za asubuhi. Tunashughulikia nambari za usajili ndani ya siku 7 za kazi. Kamwe usishughulikie madalali. Ripoti visa vya ufisadi kwa @EACCKenya
Dholuo: Okinyi maber . Watiyo gi ndalo abiriyo mag tich e loso plede. Kik iti kod broka. Chiw  Ripot mar mibadhi ne @EACCKenya.

English: Good evening. Please note the Duty field has been updated as PAID and your records were updated. You can now view your vehicle details via the service portal.
Kiswahili: Habari za jioni. Tafadhali kumbuka kuwa sehemu ya Ushuru imesasishwa kama IMALIPO na rekodi zako zimesasishwa. Sasa unaweza kuona maelezo ya gari lako kupitia lango la huduma.
Dholuo: Odhiambo maber. Ng'e ni kuonde mitiyogo e chulo osuru sani oseloki mana kaka ne ichulo, kendo weche misendikogo sani oseloki. Inyalo neno weche mag mtokni kokalo kuom websait mar tij lendo.

English: You don't need to deal with a broker to access any NTSA service. Kindly report corruption and bribery related
Kiswahili: Huna haja ya kushughulika na dalali ili kupata huduma yoyote ya NTSA. Tafadhali ripoti kuhusu ufisadi na rushwa zinazohusiana
Dholuo: Ok ochuno ni nyaka iti kod jachung' mondo iyud chenro mar NTSA. Chiw lipot mar mibadhi kod motenore kod asoya.

English: Kindly proceed to apply for a duplicate logbook from your account. Please reach out if your require any more information.
Kiswahili: Tafadhali endelea kutuma maombi ya kitabu cha kumbukumbu kutoka kwa akaunti yako. Tafadhali wasiliana nasi ikiwa unahitaji maelezo zaidi.
Dholuo: Ka diher ng'eyo weche momedore, inyalo dhi nyime kwayo mondo okonyi yudo kopi ariyo mag bugno mar mtoka.

English: No room for corruption or laziness,  CS Geoffrey Ruku has urged all public servants to uphold professionalism, report to work on time, and treat Kenyans with dignity and respect.
Kiswahili: Hakuna nafasi ya ufisadi au uvivu,  Waziri Geoffrey Ruku amewasihi watumishi wote wa umma kudumisha weledi, kuripoti kazini kwa wakati, na kuwatendea Wakenya kwa utu na heshima.
Dholuo: Onge thuolo mar mibadhi kod yulo. Geoffrey Ruku osejiwo jotich duto mag sirkal mondo oti tijegi, otim tijegi e sa mowinjore, kendo otim ne Jo-Kenya gik moko gi luor kod luor.

English: Call Toll Free line 1551 or email report@integrity.go.ke to report cases of corruption.
Kiswahili: Piga simu ya bure 1551 au tuma barua pepe kwa report@integrity.go.ke ili kuripoti visa vya ufisadi.
Dholuo: Tudri gi namba mar 1551 maonge chudo kata or e-mail report@integrity.go.ke mondo inyis ji weche mag mibadhi.

English: Please feel free to report any cases of forgery or corruption via email report@integrity.go.ke or call 1551.
Kiswahili: Tafadhali jisikie huru kuripoti visa vyovyote vya kughushi au ufisadi kupitia barua pepe report@integrity.go.ke au piga simu 1551.
Dholuo: Inyalo oro ripot moro amora mar gik mochuogi  kata mibadhi kitiyo gi e-mail@integrity.go.ke kata igo simo e namba mar 1551.

English: Report via email report@integrity.go.ke or call 1551 in case you have specific corruption cases which need action.
Kiswahili: Ripoti kupitia barua pepe report@integrity.go.ke au piga simu 1551 ikiwa una kesi maalum za ufisadi zinazohitaji hatua.
Dholuo: Chiw lipot kitiyo gi e-mail report@integrity.go.ke kata luong namba 1551 kapo ni in gi weche moko ma nyiso ni idwaro kawo okang'.

English: If you have any particular cases of corruption you need to report, please do so via email report@integrity.go.ke or call 1551.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa una visa vyovyote maalum vya ufisadi unavyohitaji kuripoti, tafadhali fanya hivyo kupitia barua pepe report@integrity.go.ke au piga simu 1551.
Dholuo: Kapo ni in gi wach moro ma chandi, inyalo ndiko wachno e adres mar@integrity.go.ke kata inyalo ywayo tol e namba mar 1551.

English: Meru Huduma Centre launches Customer Service Week: Members of the public have been urged to seek various Government services.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Huduma cha Meru chazindua Wiki ya Huduma kwa Wateja: Umma umehimizwa kutafuta huduma mbalimbali za Serikali.

English: This comprehensive approach aims to maximize outreach, fostering ongoing discussions on HIV prevention, and treatment, as well as addressing issues like sexual and gender-based violence, teen pregnancies, and COVID-19.

English: The epidemiology of cholera for Kenya in 2017 is characterized by continuous transmission in affected communities coupled with outbreaks in camp settings and institutions or during mass gathering events.
Kiswahili: Ugonjwa wa kipindupindu nchini Kenya mwaka wa 2017 una sifa ya maambukizi ya mara kwa mara katika jamii zilizoathirika pamoja na milipuko katika maeneo ya kambi na taasisi au wakati wa mikusanyiko ya watu wengi.
Dholuo: Okang’ ma ng’ato nyalo yudoe tuwo mar kolera e piny Kenya e higa mar 2017, ochung’ne ng’ado bura ma dhi nyime e alwora ma oyudo tuwono kaachiel gi ng’ado bura e kuonde ma ji ochung’ie kod kuonde ma ji odak e iye kata e kinde ma ji mang’eny romoe.

English: Continuous transmission in the community accounts for around 70% of the total cases with the majority of cases coming from the capital county, Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Uambukizaji unaoendelea katika jamii huchangia karibu 70% ya jumla ya visa huku visa vingi vikitoka katika kaunti kuu, Nairobi.
Dholuo: Odhi nyime gi lando tuwono e alwora kelo 70% mar kes duto ma thoth kesgo wuok e kaunti maduong’, Nairobi.

English: Transmission in camp settings occurred mainly within Garissa and Turkana counties, accounting for around 23% of the total reported cases.
Kiswahili: Usambazaji katika mipangilio ya kambi ulifanyika hasa katika kaunti za Garissa na Turkana, zikichukua takriban 23% ya jumla ya visa vilivyoripotiwa.
Dholuo: Oganda ma ne oyudo tuwono ne otimore ahinya e kind gwenge mag Garissa kod Turkana, ma ne oting’o 23% mar kwan mar jogo ma ne oyudo tuwono.

English: Both counties host big refugee camps, namely Dadaab and Kakuma refugee camps.
Kiswahili: Kaunti zote mbili zina kambi kubwa za wakimbizi, ambazo ni kambi za wakimbizi za Dadaab na Kakuma.
Dholuo: Kaunti ariyogo duto nigi kambi madongo mag jolweny, ma gin kambi mag jolweny mag Dadaab kod Kakuma.

English: Refugees in these camps come from countries currently experiencing complex emergencies and large cholera outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Wakimbizi katika kambi hizi wanatoka katika nchi ambazo kwa sasa zinakabiliwa na dharura tata na milipuko mikubwa ya kipindupindu.
Dholuo: Jolweny ma ni e kambi ma kamago wuok e pinje ma sani yudo masira mapek ahinya kendo ma nigi tuwo maduong’ mar kolera.

English: Seven percent of cases occurred in institutions and mass gathering events, where a number of people get infected from a point source.
Kiswahili: Asilimia saba ya visa vilitokea katika taasisi na hafla za mkusanyiko mkubwa, ambapo watu kadhaa huambukizwa kutoka kwa chanzo cha uhakika.
Dholuo: Abiriyo kuom mia achiel mag kesgo ne otimore e kuonde ma ji mang’eny romoe, kama kwan mar ji yudoe tuwono kowuok e kama giyudoree.

English: The country experiences cholera outbreaks every year; however, large cyclical epidemics occur approximately every five to seven years and last for two to three years.
Kiswahili: Nchi inakumbwa na milipuko ya kipindupindu kila mwaka; hata hivyo, magonjwa makubwa ya milipuko ya mzunguko hutokea takriban kila baada ya miaka mitano hadi saba na hudumu kwa miaka miwili hadi mitatu.
Dholuo: Pinyno yudo tuoche mag kolera higa ka higa; kata kamano, tuoche madongo ma ng’ato nyalo ng’ado e kindgi timore chiegni bang’ higni abich nyaka abiro kendo gibedo kuom higni ariyo nyaka adek.

English: The country has activated the national task force to coordinate the outbreak response activities.
Kiswahili: Nchi imeanzisha kikosi kazi cha kitaifa kuratibu shughuli za kukabiliana na milipuko.
Dholuo: Pinyno oseketo riwruok mar tich mar piny mangima mondo ochak tije mag geng'o tuo mar korona.

English: Since January 2017, WHO and other partners have been providing technical support to the country to control of the outbreak.
Kiswahili: Tangu Januari 2017, WHO na washirika wengine wamekuwa wakitoa msaada wa kiufundi kwa nchi kudhibiti mlipuko huo.
Dholuo: Chakre dwe mar achiel higa mar 2017, WHO kod jowete mamoko osebedo ka chiwo kony mar lony ne pinyno e thiro loyo mar korona.

English: Following the development of the national response plan, WHO and other partners supported the country to scale-up the outbreak response activities such as surveillance, case management, and social mobilization.
Kiswahili: Kufuatia kutayarishwa kwa mpango wa kitaifa wa mwitikio, WHO na washirika wengine walisaidia nchi kuongeza shughuli za kukabiliana na milipuko kama vile ufuatiliaji, udhibiti wa kesi, na uhamasishaji wa kijamii.
Dholuo: Bang’ loso chenro mar dwoko piny piny, WHO kod jowetene mamoko ne okonyo pinyno mondo omed ng’iyo tich mar dwoko piny tuo kaka ng’iyo, rito kes, kod loso oganda.

English: This was also coupled with the improvement of food hygiene standards and promotion of safe food handling, besides scaling-up Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH) related activities.
Kiswahili: Hii pia iliambatana na uboreshaji wa viwango vya usafi wa chakula na uhamasishaji wa utunzaji salama wa chakula, kando na kuongeza shughuli zinazohusiana na Maji, Usafi wa Mazingira na Usafi (WASH).
Dholuo: Mano bende ne oriwre gi bero rang’iny mar ler mar chiemo kod siro rito chiemo maber, ka ok oting’o medo kwan mar tije ma tudruok gi Pi, Rieko, kod Rieko (WASH).

English: This resulted in a decline in the number of cholera cases.
Kiswahili: Hii ilisababisha kupungua kwa idadi ya wagonjwa wa kipindupindu.
Dholuo: Mano ne omiyo kwan mar jogo ma ne oyudo tuwo mar kolera odok piny.

English: Despite the decline in the number of cases reported, the outbreak appears to be clustered around two major types of settings.
Kiswahili: Licha ya kupungua kwa idadi ya kesi zilizoripotiwa, kuzuka kunaonekana kuunganishwa karibu na aina mbili kuu za mipangilio.
Dholuo: Kata obedo ni kwan mar jogo ma oyudo tuwono osedok piny, nenore ni tuwono ochung’ e alwora ariyo madongo.

English: First, the refugee camps particularly Kakuma and Dadaab, and second in the populous Nairobi capital county.
Kiswahili: Kwanza, kambi za wakimbizi hasa Kakuma na Dadaab, na pili katika kaunti yenye watu wengi ya Nairobi.
Dholuo: Mokwongo, ne gin kambi mag jolweny ahinya ahinya e Kakuma kod Dadaab, to mar ariyo ne gin e gweng' maduong' mar Nairobi man kod oganda mathoth.

English: This could enable the spread of the outbreak to other districts.
Kiswahili: Hii inaweza kuwezesha kuenea kwa mlipuko katika wilaya zingine.
Dholuo: Mano nyalo miyo tuwono olandre e distrikt mamoko.

English: Also, previous outbreaks have shown that cases increase during the rainy season, which has started recently.
Kiswahili: Pia, milipuko ya awali imeonyesha kuwa kesi huongezeka wakati wa mvua, ambayo imeanza hivi karibuni.
Dholuo: Bende, tuoche ma osetimore chon osenyiso ni tuoche medore e kinde koth, ma osechako machiegni.

English: In addition, various physical, social, political, and environmental factors increase the vulnerability and the susceptibility of the country’s population to the cholera outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, mambo mbalimbali ya kimwili, kijamii, kisiasa na kimazingira huongeza hatari na uwezekano wa idadi ya watu nchini kwa milipuko ya kipindupindu.
Dholuo: Bende, gik mopogore opogore ma timore e ringruok, e kind oganda, e siasa, kod e alwora medo bedo gi nyalo mar bedo gi tuwo mar kolera kendo bedo gi nyalo mar yudo tuwo mar kolera.

English: These include regional drought, conflict, and insecurity in the Horn of Africa, and the increased movement within and to the country by people fleeing conflicts in Somalia and South Sudan.
Kiswahili: Hizi ni pamoja na ukame wa kikanda, migogoro, na ukosefu wa usalama katika Pembe ya Afrika, na kuongezeka kwa harakati ndani na ndani ya nchi na watu wanaokimbia migogoro nchini Somalia na Sudan Kusini.
Dholuo: Magi oriwo oro, lweny, kod bedo ni onge arita e piny Tung' mar Afrika, kod medruok mar wuoth ei pinyno kendo donjo e pinyno kuom oganda maring'o lwenje e piny Somalia kod Sudan ma Milambo.

English: Overall, the risk of the current outbreak is assessed as high at the national level and low at the regional and global levels.
Kiswahili: Kwa ujumla, hatari ya mlipuko wa sasa inatathminiwa kuwa ya juu katika ngazi ya kitaifa na chini katika viwango vya kikanda na kimataifa.
Dholuo: Kuom duto, nyalo mar bedo gi tuwo ma sani nitie, opim ni en gima duong’ ahinya e rang’iny mar piny kendo ni piny e rang’iny mar ng’om kod piny mangima.

English: WHO recommends proper and timely case management in cholera treatment centres.
Kiswahili: WHO inapendekeza usimamizi sahihi na kwa wakati wa kesi katika vituo vya matibabu ya kipindupindu.
Dholuo: WHO ogolo paro ni mondo otimnegi thieth mowinjore kendo e kinde mowinjore e kuonde thieth mag kolera.

English: The affected communities should have improved access to water, effective sanitation, proper waste management, and enhanced hygiene and food safety practices.
Kiswahili: Jamii zilizoathiriwa zinapaswa kuboresha upatikanaji wa maji, vyoo bora, udhibiti sahihi wa taka, na kuimarisha kanuni za usafi na usalama wa chakula.
Dholuo: Jodak ma ne oyudo masirano ne onego obed gi yore maber mag yudo pi, rito ler maber, rito yugi maber, kod yore mabeyo mag rito ler kod chiemo.

English: Key public health communication messages should be provided.
Kiswahili: Ujumbe muhimu wa mawasiliano ya afya ya umma unapaswa kutolewa.
Dholuo: Owinjore omi weche madongo mag tudruok e wi thieth mar oganda.

English: WHO encourages travellers to the affected area to take proper hygiene precautions to prevent potential exposure.
Kiswahili: WHO inawahimiza wasafiri kwenda eneo lililoathiriwa kuchukua tahadhari sahihi za usafi ili kuzuia kuambukizwa.
Dholuo: WHO jiwo jolendo ma dhi e kuonde ma tuono oyudoree mondo okaw okang’ mowinjore mar rito ler mondo kik giyud tuono.

English: WHO does not recommend any restriction on travel and trade to Kenya based on the information available on the current outbreak.
Kiswahili: WHO haipendekezi vikwazo vyovyote vya usafiri na biashara hadi Kenya kulingana na taarifa zilizopo kuhusu mlipuko wa sasa.
Dholuo: WHO ok ogolo chik moro amora kuom wuotho ​​kod ohala e piny Kenya kaluwore gi weche ma nitie e wi tuo mar korona.

English: Disease outbreak - Cholera - Kenya - 21 July 2017 | WHO | Regional Office for Africa
Kiswahili: Mlipuko wa magonjwa - Kipindupindu - Kenya - 21 Julai 2017 | NANI | Ofisi ya Kanda ya Afrika
Dholuo: Tuwo ma ng’ato nyalo ng’ado - Kolera - Kenya - 21 dwe mar Julaini higa mar 2017 | NG’ANO | Ofis mar Kinda mar Afrika

English: Since the beginning of 2017, Kenya is experiencing an upsurge of cholera cases.
Kiswahili: Tangu mwanzoni mwa 2017, Kenya inakabiliwa na ongezeko la wagonjwa wa kipindupindu.
Dholuo: Chakre chakruok mar higa mar 2017, piny Kenya yudo omedruok mar tuo mar kolera.

English: The first cholera outbreak reported in 2017 was in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Mlipuko wa kwanza wa kipindupindu kuripotiwa mwaka wa 2017 ulikuwa katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Dholuo: Tuwo mar kolera mokwongo mane oyudre e higa mar 2017 ne en e Kaunti mar Tana River.

English: The outbreak started on 10 October 2016 and was controlled by April 2017.
Kiswahili: Mlipuko huo ulianza tarehe 10 Oktoba 2016 na ulidhibitiwa ifikapo Aprili 2017.
Dholuo: Two no ne ochakore tarik 10 dwe mar Apar higa mar 2016 kendo ne olohi kokalo dwe mar Ang'wen higa mar 2017.

English: A second wave of cholera outbreaks started in Garissa County on 2 April 2017 and was reported later in nine other counties including Nairobi, Murang’a, Vihiga, Mombasa, Turkana, Kericho, Nakuru, Kiambu, and Narok.
Kiswahili: Wimbi la pili la mkurupuko wa kipindupindu lilianza katika Kaunti ya Garissa mnamo 2 Aprili 2017 na kuripotiwa baadaye katika kaunti zingine tisa zikiwemo Nairobi, Murang’a, Vihiga, Mombasa, Turkana, Kericho, Nakuru, Kiambu, na Narok.
Dholuo: Awa mar ariyo mar midhiero mar kolera ne ochakre e gweng' mar Garissa tarik 2 dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2017 kendo bang'e ne owinre e gweng' mamoko 9 moriwo Nairobi, Murang'a, Vihiga, Mombasa, Turkana, Kericho, Nakuru, Kiambu, kod Narok.

English: The outbreak is being reported in the general population and in refugee camps.
Kiswahili: Mlipuko huo unaripotiwa katika idadi ya watu na katika kambi za wakimbizi.
Dholuo: Oganda mathoth kendo e kambi mag jolweny osebedo ka ng’iyo pinyno.

English: In Garissa County, the outbreak is affecting mainly Dadaab refugee camps and cases and deaths are being reported from Hagadera, Dagahaleh, and IFO2 camps.
Kiswahili: Katika Kaunti ya Garissa, mlipuko huo unaathiri zaidi kambi za wakimbizi za Dadaab na visa na vifo vinaripotiwa kutoka kambi za Hagadera, Dagahaleh, na IFO2.
Dholuo: E Kambi mar Garissa, tuo no omako ahinya kambi mag jolwen ma Dadaab kendo kes kod tho iyudore kowuok e kambi mag Hagadera, Dagahaleh, kod IFO2.

English: In Turkana county, the disease is also affecting Kakuma and Kalobeyei refugee camps.
Kiswahili: Katika kaunti ya Turkana, ugonjwa huo pia unaathiri kambi za wakimbizi za Kakuma na Kalobeyei.
Dholuo: E aluora mar Turkana, tuo ni bende omako kambi jolwen mag Kakuma kod Kalobeyei.

English: In addition to the outbreak reported in the general population, there have been two point source cholera outbreaks in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Mbali na mkurupuko huo ulioripotiwa katika idadi ya watu, kumekuwa na milipuko miwili ya chanzo cha kipindupindu katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Dholuo: Kaachiel gi tuo mar kolera ma oseyudore e kind oganda duto, nitie tuoche ariyo ma osebedo ka kelo tuoche mag kolera e gweng’ mar Nairobi.

English: One occurred among participants attending a conference in a Nairobi hotel on 22 June 2017.
Kiswahili: Moja ilitokea miongoni mwa washiriki waliohudhuria kongamano katika hoteli moja Nairobi tarehe 22 Juni 2017.
Dholuo: Achiel ne otimore e kind jogo mane ochopo e chokruok e otel moro ma Nairobi tarik 22 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2017.

English: A total of 146 patients associated with this outbreak have been treated in different hospitals in Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya wagonjwa 146 wanaohusishwa na mkurupuko huu wametibiwa katika hospitali tofauti jijini Nairobi.
Dholuo: Jotuwo 146 ma tudruok gi tuwoni osethiedh e osiptal mopogore opogore mag Nairobi.

English: A second outbreak occurred at the China Trade Fair held at the KICC Tsavo Ball between 10 and 12 July 2017.
Kiswahili: Mlipuko wa pili ulitokea katika Maonyesho ya Biashara ya Uchina yaliyofanyika kwenye Mpira wa KICC Tsavo kati ya tarehe 10 na 12 Julai 2017.
Dholuo: Okang' mar ariyo ne otimore e nyiso mar ohala mar China mane olose e KICC Tsavo Ball e kind tarik 10 gi 12 dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2017.

English: A total of 136 cases were reported and one death.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya kesi 136 ziliripotiwa na kifo kimoja.
Dholuo: Ne oyudo kes 136 kendo achiel notho.

English: Currently, the outbreak is active in two counties, namely Garissa and Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Kwa sasa, mkurupuko huo unaendelea katika kaunti mbili, ambazo ni Garissa na Nairobi.
Dholuo: Kuom sani, loch ni olandore e kaunti ariyo, ma gin Garissa kod Nairobi.

English: As of 17 July 2017, a total of 1216 suspected cases including 14 deaths (case fatality rate: 1.2%) have been reported since 1 January 2017.
Kiswahili: Kufikia tarehe 17 Julai 2017, jumla ya kesi 1216 zinazoshukiwa ikiwa ni pamoja na vifo 14 (kiwango cha vifo vya kesi: 1.2%) zimeripotiwa tangu 1 Januari 2017.
Dholuo: Kaka 17 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2017, kwan mar kes 1216 ma igeno ni nigi tuo mar tho ma oting’o tho 14 (kwan mar tho mag kes: 1.2%) osetimre chakre tarik 1 dwe mar achiel higa mar 2017.

English: In the week ending 16 July 2017, a total of 38 cases with no deaths were reported.
Kiswahili: Katika wiki inayoishia tarehe 16 Julai 2017, jumla ya visa 38 bila vifo viliripotiwa.
Dholuo: E juma ma ne orum tarik 16 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2017, ne oyudre ni ji 38 ma onge ng’at ma notho.

English: A total of 124 cases tested positive for Vibrio cholerae in the reference laboratory.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya visa 124 vilipatikana na Vibrio cholerae katika maabara ya kumbukumbu.
Dholuo: 124 ma ne oyudre gi tuo mar kolera e kar ranyisi ma ne itiyogo.

English: In the week ending 25 June 2017, 18 samples out of 25 tested positive for Vibrio cholerae Ogawa by culture at the National Public Health Laboratory in Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Wiki inayoishia tarehe 25 Juni 2017, sampuli 18 kati ya 25 zilithibitishwa kuwa na Vibrio cholerae Ogawa kulingana na utamaduni katika Maabara ya Kitaifa ya Afya ya Umma jijini Nairobi.
Dholuo: E juma mane orumo tarik 25 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2017, sampol 18 kuom sampol 25 ne oyudi gi midhusi mar kolera kaluwore gi kit oganda e Kar Rang'iny mar Thieth mar Oganda ma Nairobi.

English: The main causative factors of the current outbreak include the high population density that is conducive to the propagation and spread of the disease, mass gatherings (a wedding party held in Karen and in a hotel during an international conference), low access to safe water and proper sanitation and the massive population movements in country and with neighbouring countries.
Kiswahili: Sababu kuu za mlipuko wa sasa ni pamoja na msongamano mkubwa wa watu ambao unafaa kwa uenezi na kuenea kwa ugonjwa huo, mikusanyiko ya watu wengi (karamu ya harusi iliyofanyika Karen na katika hoteli wakati wa mkutano wa kimataifa), upatikanaji mdogo wa maji salama na usafi wa mazingira unaofaa na harakati kubwa ya watu nchini na nchi jirani.
Dholuo: Gik madongo ma kelo tuo mar korona gin kaka kwan maduong’ mar oganda ma nyalo konyo e lando kendo lando tuo mar korona, chokruok mathoth (nyasi mar keny ma ne otim e Karen kendo e otel e kinde chokruok mar piny mangima), yudo pi maler kod ler mowinjore kod kwan maduong’ mar oganda ma ni e pinje ma machiegni.

English: Since December 2014, the Republic of Kenya has been experiencing continuous large outbreaks of cholera, with a cumulative total of 17 597 cases reported (10 568 cases reported in 2015 and 6448 in 2016).
Kiswahili: Tangu Desemba 2014, Jamhuri ya Kenya imekuwa ikikumbwa na milipuko mikubwa ya kipindupindu, na jumla ya kesi 17 597 zimeripotiwa (kesi 10 568 ziliripotiwa mwaka wa 2015 na 6448 mwaka wa 2016).
Dholuo: Chakre dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2014, piny Kenya osebedo ka yudo tuoche madongo mag kolera ma dhi nyime, kendo kwan mar jogo ma oyudo tuwo mar kolera romo 17 597 (tuwo 10 568 ma ne oyudo e higa mar 2015 to 6448 e higa mar 2016).

English: The country has activated the national task force to coordinate the response to the outbreak.
Kiswahili: Nchi imeanzisha kikosi kazi cha kitaifa kuratibu mwitikio wa mlipuko huo.
Dholuo: Pinyno osetiyo gi riwruok mar piny mangima mondo ochung' ne dwoko mar tuwo mar korona.

English: Since January 2017, WHO and partners are providing technical support to the country for the control of the outbreak.
Kiswahili: Tangu Januari 2017, WHO na washirika wanatoa msaada wa kiufundi kwa nchi kwa udhibiti wa mlipuko huo.
Dholuo: Chakre dwe mar achiel higa mar 2017, WHO kod jowetene chiwo kony mar lony ne pinyno e thiro midhiero mar korona.

English: The country will develop a response plan with focus on the preparedness interventions to avert further spread of the outbreak.
Kiswahili: Nchi itaandaa mpango wa majibu kwa kuzingatia hatua za kujitayarisha ili kuzuia kuenea zaidi kwa mlipuko huo.
Dholuo: Piny biro loso chenro mar dwoko ma keto pach kuom yore mag ikruok mondo ogeng’ lalruok mar tuo mar korona.

English: The WHO country office will repurpose their staff members and experts deployed in Nairobi for the management of the post El Niño effects in the Horn of Africa to support the quick control of this outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya nchi ya WHO itawatumia tena wafanyikazi wake na wataalam waliotumwa Nairobi kwa usimamizi wa athari za El Niño katika Pembe ya Afrika ili kusaidia udhibiti wa haraka wa mlipuko huu.
Dholuo: Ofis mar piny WHO biro loso kendo jotichgi kod jolony ma gioro e Nairobi mondo ochung’ ne rito gik ma nyalo timore bang’ El Niño e piny Afrika mondo okony e geng’o mapiyo tuo mar korona.

English: WHO will also support the five most at risk counties with disease surveillance and response coordination.
Kiswahili: WHO pia itaunga mkono kaunti tano zilizo hatarini zaidi na ufuatiliaji wa magonjwa na uratibu wa kukabiliana.
Dholuo: WHO bende biro konyo county abich ma ni e arita maduong’ie moloyo kuom ng’iyo tuoche kod loso chenro mar dwokogi.

English: Partners on the ground are committed to provide support to the ongoing response efforts including support to primary health care and social mobilization by United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF).
Kiswahili: Washirika mashinani wamejitolea kutoa msaada kwa juhudi zinazoendelea za kukabiliana na hali hiyo ikiwa ni pamoja na usaidizi wa huduma za afya ya msingi na uhamasishaji wa kijamii na Shirika la Umoja wa Mataifa la Kuhudumia Watoto (UNICEF).
Dholuo: Joma tiyo kanyakla e pinyno ochung’ motegno mar chiwo kony ne tich ma dhi nyime mar dwoko ma oting’o kony ne thieth mokwongo kod loso gik moko e kind oganda gi riwruok mar nyithindo mag piny mangima (UNICEF).

English: Cholera is an acute enteric infection caused by the ingestion of bacterium Vibrio cholerae present in faecally contaminated water or food.
Kiswahili: Kipindupindu ni maambukizi makali ya tumbo yanayosababishwa na kumeza bakteria aina ya Vibrio cholerae iliyopo kwenye maji au chakula kilichochafuliwa na kinyesi.
Dholuo: Kolera en tuwo mager mar ich ma ikelo gi ng’ato ka ng’ato ma ng’ato ochamo gik ma kelo kwiri ma iye ( Vibrio kolerae ) ma yudore e pi kata chiemo ma nigi lak.

English: It is primarily linked to insufficient access to safe water and adequate sanitation.
Kiswahili: Kimsingi inahusishwa na upatikanaji duni wa maji salama na usafi wa mazingira wa kutosha.
Dholuo: Otudore ahinya gi bedo maonge gi pi maler moromo kod bedo gi ler moromo.

English: Cholera is always considered a potentially serious infectious disease and can cause high morbidity and mortality.
Kiswahili: Kipindupindu daima huchukuliwa kuwa ugonjwa hatari wa kuambukiza na unaweza kusababisha magonjwa mengi na vifo.
Dholuo: Kinde duto, kolera okawe kaka tuo ma nyalo mako ng’ato kendo nyalo kelo tuoche mang’eny kod tho mang’eny.

English: It has the potential to spread rapidly, depending on the exposure frequency, population exposed and the context.
Kiswahili: Ina uwezo wa kuenea kwa haraka, kulingana na marudio ya mfiduo, idadi ya watu inayofichuliwa na muktadha.
Dholuo: En gi nyalo mar landore mapiyo, kaluwore gi kaka ng’ato ng’iyo gik moko, kwan mar ji ma ng’iyo gik moko kod gik ma timore.

English: Cholera outbreaks have been reported in the Republic of Kenya every year with large cyclical epidemics every five to seven years.
Kiswahili: Milipuko ya kipindupindu imeripotiwa katika Jamhuri ya Kenya kila mwaka huku kukiwa na milipuko mikubwa ya mzunguko kila baada ya miaka mitano hadi saba.
Dholuo: Kolera osebedo ka yudore e piny Kenya higa ka higa ka tuoche madongo ma ng’ato nyalo ng’ado bang’ higni abich nyaka abiro.

English: The risk of the current outbreak is assessed as high at national and regional levels and moderate at global level.
Kiswahili: Hatari ya mlipuko wa sasa inatathminiwa kuwa ya juu katika viwango vya kitaifa na kikanda na wastani katika kiwango cha kimataifa.
Dholuo: Risiko mar tuo ma sani nitie, opim ni en gima duong’ ahinya e rang’iny mar piny kod mar ng’om kendo ni en mar piny mangima.

English: The outbreak occurred in the context of a sub-regional drought, conflicts and insecurity in the Horn of Africa.
Kiswahili: Mlipuko huo ulitokea katika muktadha wa ukame wa kikanda, migogoro na ukosefu wa usalama katika Pembe ya Afrika.
